name: Cookiehub
description: Embeds the CookieHub third-party cookie-consent script site-wide and provides a cookie-declaration field type/formatter.
project_description:
This module integrates the CookieHub cookie consent banner and the cookie declaration into your website.

 Features 
 
 Show the CookieHub cookie consent banner on your website. 
 A field plugin for adding the CookieHub cookie declaration.

 (You need a premium subscription for this option to work) 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Register an account at cookiehub.com 
 Add a domain on https://dash.cookiehub.com/ 
 
 Dependencies 
 This module does not have any dependencies.

 Support development 
 When registering for a new account, please use this link which contains our affiliate code. This helps support the development of this module.
